about: Hand-authored mock dataset for development and testing. Landmarks, neighbourhoods and coordinates are real Delhi locations; restaurant, bar, hotel and tour-operator names are fictional. Prices are approximate, in USD (landmark tickets use the foreign-visitor fee). Opening hours are typical; weekly closing days are not modelled. Lodging pricePerPerson is per person per night. Weather is mocked: monthly normals plus a sample daily forecast.

venues.name: Gali Paratha House
venues.description: Narrow-lane kitchen frying stuffed parathas in ghee from early morning, a short walk from the Old Delhi food walk meeting point.

venues.name: Udupi Corner
venues.description: South Indian canteen serving rice-and-lentil dosas, idli and filter coffee under the Connaught Place colonnades.

venues.name: Dariba Jalebi Corner
venues.description: Street-corner sweet shop frying fresh jalebi and serving hot milk and chai.

venues.name: Khan Market Roastery
venues.description: Upstairs coffee bar with oat-milk drinks and vegan bakes, popular with readers from the market bookshops.

venues.name: CP Coffee & Books
venues.description: Quiet cafe inside a secondhand bookshop in the inner circle of Connaught Place.

venues.name: Haveli Thali Kitchen
venues.description: Unlimited North Indian vegetarian thali with dal, seasonal sabzi, rotis and rice, refilled at the table.

venues.name: Green Leaf Vegan Kitchen
venues.description: Plant-based kitchen cooking millet bowls and curries without wheat, dairy or nuts.

venues.name: Tibetan Momo House
venues.description: Family-run Tibetan kitchen in the refugee colony serving momos, thukpa and butter tea.

venues.name: Jama Masjid Kebab Ghar
venues.description: Old Delhi Mughlai institution near Jama Masjid known for mutton korma, seekh kebabs and sheermal bread.

venues.name: Nizamuddin Biryani Darbar
venues.description: Biryani and nihari house in the lanes beside the Nizamuddin shrine, a short walk from Humayun's Tomb.

venues.name: Pandara Road Tandoor
venues.description: Late-night Punjabi grill famous for butter chicken, dal makhani and paneer tikka, close to India Gate.

venues.name: Shalom Paharganj Kitchen
venues.description: Kosher kitchen run by a community centre for travellers, serving Israeli and Indian vegetarian dishes.

venues.name: Lutyens Grill
venues.description: Modern Indian grill with a gluten-free menu of tandoori meats, fish and millet breads.

venues.name: Deer Park Terrace
venues.description: Rooftop bar overlooking the Hauz Khas lake and medieval ruins, busiest after sunset.

venues.name: Red Fort
venues.description: Seventeenth-century Mughal fort of red sandstone with palaces, gardens and a museum. Allow about two hours.

venues.name: Qutub Minar
venues.description: Seventy-three-metre victory tower from 1193 in a complex of early Delhi Sultanate ruins and an iron pillar.

venues.name: Humayun's Tomb
venues.description: Garden tomb of the Mughal emperor Humayun, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and forerunner of the Taj Mahal.

venues.name: Akshardham Exhibitions
venues.description: Hindu temple complex; the ticket covers the exhibition halls, boat ride and evening water show. Phones are not allowed inside.

venues.name: National Museum
venues.description: India's largest museum, from Harappan seals to Mughal miniatures and a Buddhist relics gallery.

venues.name: National Gallery of Modern Art
venues.description: Indian art from the 1850s onward in a former maharaja's palace near India Gate.

venues.name: National Crafts Museum
venues.description: Folk and tribal crafts, a recreated village complex and artisans demonstrating their work.

venues.name: Old Delhi Food Walk
venues.description: Three-hour guided walk through the bazaars of Chandni Chowk with ten tastings; vegetarian route on request.

venues.name: Lodhi Garden & Art District Walk
venues.description: Morning walk past fifteenth-century tombs in Lodhi Garden and the street murals of Lodhi Colony.

venues.name: India Gate Evening Cycle Tour
venues.description: Guided bicycle ride along Kartavya Path to India Gate as the monuments light up.

venues.name: Chandni Chowk Rickshaw Ride
venues.description: Forty-minute cycle-rickshaw ride through the spice market and wholesale lanes of Old Delhi.

venues.name: Paharganj Backpackers Inn
venues.description: Budget guesthouse with private rooms and dorms beside New Delhi railway station.

venues.name: Connaught Courtyard Hotel
venues.description: Mid-range hotel in a colonial building on the Connaught Place circle, near the Rajiv Chowk metro.

venues.name: Lutyens Heritage Bungalow
venues.description: Eight-room boutique stay in a 1930s bungalow with a garden, between Khan Market and Lodhi Garden.
